1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OppositePairs
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SixVertexCuts
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.PairedGraphClassification
4 
5 /-! The four remaining original vertex-edge graphs, obtained from the geometric polyhedron. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 /-- A canonical graph name and concrete labels for all six original vertices. -/
10 structure SixVertexGraph (P : ConvexPolyhedron) where
11   kind : SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind
12   vertex : Fin 6 ≃ P.Vertex
13   edges : ∀ i j : Fin 6, P.edgeGraph.Adj (vertex i) (vertex j) ↔
14     i ≠ j ∧ s(i, j) ∉ kind.missingEdges
15 
16 /-- Every remaining six-vertex graph without a universal vertex has one of the four canonical forms. -/
17 theorem exists_six_vertex_graph (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (size : P.vertices.card = 6)
18     (no_universal : ¬ ∃ v : P.Vertex, ∀ w, w ≠ v → P.edgeGraph.Adj v w)
19     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
20       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) : Nonempty P.SixVertexGraph := by
21   classical
22   obtain ⟨pairs⟩ := P.exists_opposite_pairs size no_universal small_faces
23   let standard : (Bool × Fin 3) ≃ Fin 6 := Equiv.ofBijective (SmallGraphs.pairingChoices 0)
24     (SmallGraphs.pairingChoices_bijective 0)
25   let index : Fin 6 ≃ P.Vertex := standard.symm.trans pairs.vertex
26   let graph := P.edgeGraphᶜ.comap index
27   have index_pair (side : Bool) (i : Fin 3) : index (standard (side, i)) = pairs.vertex (side, i) := by
28     simp [index]
29   have matched (i : Fin 3) : graph.Adj (standard (false, i)) (standard (true, i)) := by
30     change index (standard (false, i)) ≠ index (standard (true, i)) ∧
31       ¬ P.edgeGraph.Adj (index (standard (false, i))) (index (standard (true, i)))
32     rw [index_pair, index_pair]
33     refine ⟨?_, pairs.nonedge i⟩
34     intro same
35     have impossible := congrArg Prod.fst (pairs.vertex.injective same)
36     cases impossible
37   have no_three (a b c d : Fin 6) (ab : graph.Adj a b) (ac : graph.Adj a c) (ad : graph.Adj a d) :
38       b = c ∨ b = d ∨ c = d := by
39     rcases P.six_vertices_no_three_nonneighbors size no_universal (index a) (index b) (index c) (index d)
40         ab ac ad with same | same | same
41     exacts [Or.inl (index.injective same), Or.inr (Or.inl (index.injective same)),
42       Or.inr (Or.inr (index.injective same))]
43   have no_square (labels : Fin 6 ≃ Fin 6) :
44       ¬ (graph.Adj (labels 0) (labels 2) ∧ graph.Adj (labels 0) (labels 3) ∧
45         graph.Adj (labels 1) (labels 2) ∧ graph.Adj (labels 1) (labels 3)) :=
46     P.no_complement_square (labels.trans index)
47   obtain ⟨k, classified⟩ := SmallGraphs.classify_paired_graph graph
48     (matched 0) (matched 1) (matched 2) no_three no_square
49   let labels : Fin 6 ≃ Fin 6 := Equiv.ofBijective (SmallGraphs.pairedGraphChoices k).2
50     (SmallGraphs.pairedGraphChoices_bijective k)
51   refine ⟨{
52     kind := (SmallGraphs.pairedGraphChoices k).1
53     vertex := labels.trans index
54     edges := ?_
55   }⟩
56   intro i j
57   have nonedges := classified i j
58   change P.edgeGraphᶜ.Adj (index (labels i)) (index (labels j)) ↔ _ at nonedges
59   change P.edgeGraph.Adj (index (labels i)) (index (labels j)) ↔ _
60   rw [SimpleGraph.compl_adj] at nonedges
61   have distinct : index (labels i) ≠ index (labels j) ↔ i ≠ j := by
62     simp only [index.injective.ne_iff, labels.injective.ne_iff]
63   rw [distinct] at nonedges
64   constructor
65   · intro edge
66     exact ⟨fun same => edge.ne (same ▸ rfl), fun missing => (nonedges.mpr missing).2 edge⟩
67   · rintro ⟨different, not_missing⟩
68     by_contra not_edge
69     exact not_missing (nonedges.mp ⟨different, not_edge⟩)
70 
71 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
